opportunity.subject: one recurring internal process, six people, every week
opportunity.notes: No money changes hands. The unit is hours, and the ratio works the same.

cost_detached.evidence: Six hours a week produce about thirty minutes of information nobody already had. The other five and a half hours exist because the format does.

absorbable.evidence: The expensive part is assembly, and the team doing the assembling is the team deciding.

soft_barrier.evidence: Nothing technical stops this changing. It continues because changing it requires telling someone senior that their table is not read.

existing_need.evidence: Someone genuinely needs to know what is happening. They do not need it in this shape, and possibly not weekly.

pulls_help.evidence: Nobody will volunteer to help fix a status report. This screen scores honestly at zero and the total should carry that.

reachable_proof.evidence: Skip it for two weeks and count who asks. That is the whole experiment.

requirements.text: Every report must be reviewed before it goes out
Must include the headcount and hiring pipeline table
Must go out before the Monday leadership call

steps.name: Collect per-team updates in a shared doc
Compile metrics into the standard table
Chase three people who did not fill theirs in

components.name: One week's report, end to end
